description: Resume by thread id after a relaunch: the host's first command is resume with the thread id from session_init, then the continue prompt (queued until the thread is loaded). The adapter resumes the thread (thread/resume, same cwd and mode) instead of starting one; the CLI re-reports the same thread, whose earlier turns stay in Codex's own history, and the prompt becomes the next turn. Synthesised from the codex app-server JSON schema generated by codex-cli 0.144.1 (`codex app-server generate-json-schema`), not captured from a live run: replace with a capture (see crates/codex-adapter/README.md).
